name: product-row-card
title: Product row card
description: A list-view product card for search results: picture, title, rating and facts, then the price block, stock in words and the actions.
docs: Prices are Money in minor units. The title is the stretched link; Add to cart and your wishlist control stay separate controls above it. onAddToCart may return a promise to show the busy state, and ProductRowCardSkeleton stands in while a list loads. On a phone the price block stacks above a full-width Add to cart that is 40px high, so give a wishlist control the same height.
